newsitem.title: JAPAN: Hitachi shares rise after rating upgrade.
newsitem.headline: Hitachi shares rise after rating upgrade.

text.p: Shares in Hitachi Ltd were higher in early Wednesday afternoon trade after the company's rating was upgraded, brokers said.
At 0421 GMT, the shares were 10 yen higher at 1,090 yen, with a trade volume of 4.291 million shares.
Earlier on Wednesday, Nomura Research Institute Ltd upgraded its rating for Hitachi to a "1" from its previous "2", market sources said. Nomura officials were not immediately available for comment.

In its three-grade rating system, the research institute assigns a "1" rating to issues whose values it expects will outperform the key 225-share Nikkei average by more than 10 percentage points over the following six months.
